alternatives.option: Disable the whole twining plugin per-project
alternatives.reason_rejected: Loses hooks/skills/gates — the plugin's main value during beta soak
Claude Code bug #9427: env expansion not applied to plugin .mcp.json
Would silently promote every plugin user to the beta channel

context: Fixed dual twining MCP server issue from beta enrollment: disabled plugin:twining:twining in shared .claude/settings.json, added plugin caveat to UPGRADE-v2.md beta section, created amended enrollment draft in Gmail
rationale: Disabling just the plugin's MCP server (key: plugin:twining:twining, verified via claude mcp list) keeps the plugin's hooks, skills, and gates active while eliminating the duplicate 1.x server. Placed in the checked-in shared settings.json rather than settings.local.json because this repo's .mcp.json pins @next for everyone, so the plugin server is redundant for every contributor. The elegant alternative — ${TWINING_MCP_VERSION:-^1.20.0} expansion in plugin/.mcp.json — is blocked upstream: env expansion does not work in plugin .mcp.json (anthropics/claude-code#9427).
summary: Chose disabledMcpjsonServers in shared .claude/settings.json over disabling the plugin or env-var version switching in plugin/.mcp.json
